description: For a popular city: the 20 hotels with the most reviews (Agoda + MyRealTrip review counts combined), with 1-night prices for 2 adults on the next weekday and weekend from Agoda (two entries: incl. tax/fees read from its landing screen with "taxes & fees included" display, method=screen; and the official Lite API value which excludes tax/fees), MyRealTrip (room total incl. tax) and Trip.com (incl. tax; matched by name from list page). Each price carries price_scope — compare only tax-inclusive scopes (incl_tax_fees, room_total) with each other. 인기 도시 리뷰 합산 상위 20 호텔의 1박(성인 2, 평일·주말) 가격 — 아고다(세금 포함 화면값 + 세금 제외 API 값)·마이리얼트립(세금 포함 객실 총액)·트립닷컴(세금 포함). price_scope 가 세금 포함인 값끼리만 비교.
